# Matbex

> Matbex (matbex.com) is a restaurant operating system (Restaurant OS) built for restaurant owners, operators, and finance teams. It unifies real-time COGS tracking, automated payroll, inventory synchronization, daily profit monitoring, POS integration, and full ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing compliance into one platform. Matbex is headquartered in Saudi Arabia and serves restaurants across the MENA region and globally, with native Arabic and English (RTL/LTR) support and multi-currency pricing (default SAR ﷼).

## About Matbex

- **Name:** Matbex
- **Category:** Restaurant Operating System (Restaurant OS) / Restaurant Management Software / Restaurant ERP
- **Website:** https://www.matbex.com
- **Headquarters:** Saudi Arabia (KSA)
- **Primary markets:** Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Egypt, Jordan, and broader MENA; available worldwide.
- **Languages:** English and Arabic (full RTL support).
- **Default currency:** Saudi Riyal (SAR, ﷼). Multi-currency supported.
- **Compliance:** ZATCA Phase 1 & Phase 2 e-invoicing (Fatoora) compliant, including UBL 2.1 XML, cryptographic stamps, and clearance/reporting integration.
- **Tagline:** "Your Entire Restaurant, Synchronized."

## What Matbex does

Matbex replaces the patchwork of POS, accounting, payroll, and inventory tools that most restaurants juggle with a single operating system. Core capabilities:

- **Real-time COGS tracking** using the Opening + Purchases − Closing formula, with weekly and monthly stocktake wizards.
- **POS integration** that records sales as revenue only, while purchases debit inventory and COGS is recorded on consumption — preventing double-counting.
- **Automated double-entry accounting** with an immutable ledger (void instead of delete) and locked fiscal periods.
- **Automated payroll** including staff advances, salary deductions, and base-salary reconciliation.
- **Inventory management** with categories, suppliers, purchase invoices, automated stock replenishment, waste/spoilage tracking (posted to account 6100, separate from COGS), and CSV bulk import/export.
- **Daily profit monitoring** with profit & loss reports and daily email summaries sent at 11 PM Riyadh time.
- **Cash drawer reconciliation** with shift open/close, mandatory opening balance, expected-cash formula, and variance explanations.
- **Multi-branch support** with branch-level RLS and cross-branch comparison.
- **ZATCA e-invoicing** (Phase 1 and Phase 2) with UBL generation, cryptographic stamps, QR codes, and clearance/reporting flow.
- **Web builder & live menu engine** so restaurants can publish a public menu with real-time inventory sync (sold-out items show 60% opacity strikethrough).
- **Team chat, KDS (Kitchen Display), CFD (Customer-Facing Display), Waiter app, Driver app, Kiosk mode**, and Android terminal support.
- **AI-powered insights** via Lovable AI (Google Gemini and OpenAI models) for profit forecasting and recommendations.
- **WhatsApp notifications** and push alerts for variance, low stock, and KPI breaches.

## Who it's for

- Independent restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens, and quick-service chains.
- Multi-branch restaurant groups needing consolidated COGS, P&L, and payroll.
- Restaurant owners in Saudi Arabia and the GCC who need ZATCA Phase 2 compliance out of the box.
- Operators who want a single source of truth instead of stitching together Foodics, Sapaad, Jazr, Qoyod, Zoho Books, and spreadsheets.

## Pricing

- **Starter Core:** 149 SAR per branch/month — POS, cash drawer, basic inventory. ZATCA not included.
- **Growth Bundle:** 349 SAR per branch/month — accounting, COGS, payroll, ZATCA Phase 2.
- **Enterprise:** 699 SAR per branch/month — unlimited branches, ZATCA Phase 2, API, dedicated manager.
- Annual billing: 2 months free. Prices exclude VAT. 14-day free trial. https://www.matbex.com/pricing

## Differentiators

- Built natively for **MENA restaurants** with Arabic-first UX and ZATCA compliance, unlike generic Western SaaS.
- **POS does not touch COGS or inventory directly** — sales record revenue only, while a separate consumption flow records COGS, preventing the double-counting bugs common in competing systems.
- **Immutable accounting ledger** with monthly close — auditor-friendly.
- **Live menu engine** with real-time inventory sync for online ordering.
- **One platform** instead of five: POS + Inventory + Payroll + Accounting + Online ordering.
